items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: He came down alone so they searched through the school to find a clarinet player and a piano player and they found me and another guy and we played the thing with Gene.

ctx.x: While I was downstairs, the Benny Goodman Trio, Gene Krupa and Benny and Teddy Wilson were very big, and Krupa came down to N.Y.U. to give a jazz concert.

He came down alone so they searched through the school to find a clarinet player and a piano player and they found me and another guy and we played the thing with Gene. I remember calling him a few years after that, when he formed
his own band; he didn't remember me. I never got to join his band.
